//: The project's Root Directory is set to app/ in Vercel's settings, so every
command below already runs from there — an earlier `cd app` failed with
'No such file or directory' for exactly that reason. Paths here are
therefore relative to app/, not the repo root.
The SPA rewrite is not optional: without it any deep link or hard refresh
returns 404, because a static host has no route table.
/model/ is ~6 MB of weights, labels and sign data that only change when the
model is retrained, and the filenames change when it is. Immutable caching
is therefore safe and saves re-downloading it on every visit.
